topics.title: What is Scale and Systems of Measurement

concepts.learning_objective: Explain map scale as the ratio between map distance and the corresponding ground distance.
Recall the units of the Metric and English systems of measurement and convert between them.

topics.title: Statement of Scale and Graphical Scale

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the statement of scale method with its advantages and limitations.
Explain why the graphical or bar scale stays valid when a map is reduced or enlarged.
Interpret a representative fraction as a ratio of map distance to ground distance in the same units.
Explain why the representative fraction is the universal method of scale.
Convert a statement of scale into a representative fraction.
Convert a representative fraction into a statement of scale in a given system.
Calculate the length of line and divisions needed to construct a graphical scale.
Apply the angled-line method to divide an uneven line into equal parts.
